## Frequently Asked Questions

### GENERAL

What is Calm?

Calm is the #1 mental health app designed to help you manage stress, sleep better, and live a
happier, healthier life. Our research-based tools help you build life-changing habits to support
your mental health. If you're having trouble falling asleep, our 500+ [Sleep Stories][3]®,
soundscapes, and guided [sleep meditations][4] can lull you to sleep. If you're spiraling in
negative thoughts and need immediate relief, our 60-second Breathe Bubble grounds you in the moment
and helps your body return to a state of relaxation. If you're overwhelmed at work and need a
breather, our [stress and burnout specialists][5] can guide you through exercises to help calm your
mind. We're here for you whenever or wherever you need us with more content and tools being added
monthly.

What's included in a Calm subscription?

A Calm subscription unlocks our full library of [meditations][6], [Sleep Stories][7], [music][8],
and other features. The subscription includes:
* Multiple original [daily offerings][9] from a range of teachers to give your day a dose of wisdom,
  gratitude and encouragement
* Hours of [guided meditations][10] covering sleep, anxiety, stress, gratitude, and much more
* Our entire library of more than 500+ [Sleep Stories][11], with new stories added every week
* Exclusive [music][12] tracks for focus, relaxation, and sleep

Where should I get started once I download the app?

If you have come to Calm to learn relaxation techniques and improve aspects of your mental health,
we recommend beginning with the [7 Days of Calm][13], our introductory program that offers the
basics of meditation, and then move on to the [21 Days of Calm][14]. With that foundation, you can
explore our library of sessions and programs, which address themes such as [anxiety][15],
[sleep][16], [focus][17], and [gratitude][18]. Additionally, for moments of acute stress or anxiety,
we offer in-the-moment calming exercises via our [Panic SOS][19], [Body Scan][20], and breathing
exercise features.

If you have come to Calm to improve your sleep, we have a collection of over 500 [Sleep Stories][21]
to help you drift off to restful sleep, ranging from [classic literature][22] to [nature
essays][23], [children's tales][24], scientific articles, and more. We update our Sleep Stories
selection with new options to listen to every week. We also have a collection of soothing Sleep
Music.

What devices support the Calm app?

Calm is available on iOS, Android, Web, in addition to Apple TV, Apple Watch, Google WearOS, and
Samsung Health.

How do I cancel?

You can cancel your Calm subscription's auto-renewal or free trial at any time.

To cancel your Calm subscription:
1. Tap 'Profile' on your app's Home screen.
2. Tap the 'Settings' gear icon in the top left corner of your screen.
3. Tap 'Manage Subscription' and follow the instructions here to cancel your subscription.

### MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS

What is meditation?

Meditation is the practice of allowing thoughts to come and go, as you learn to recognize and
release them without judgment. Studies show that a long-term meditation practice can actually help
shift your nervous system out of fight or flight and into the relaxed parasympathetic mode producing
a wide array of benefits* including:
* Decreased anxiety and depression symptoms
* Chronic pain management
* Lower stress levels
* Improved sleep quality

What is mindfulness?

Mindfulness is a practice that involves intentionally bringing one's attention and awareness to the
present moment without judgment. It's about being fully present and engaged in the here and now,
rather than dwelling on the past or worrying about the future. Mindfulness encourages a
non-judgmental attitude towards one's thoughts, emotions and sensations, allowing them to arise and
pass without any added stress. By cultivating mindfulness, people often develop a greater sense of
clarity, calmness and overall wellbeing, as well as enhance their ability to respond skillfully to
the challenges of life.

### STRESS & ANXIETY

What causes stress and anxiety?

Stress and anxiety can have various causes and can differ greatly from person to person. Here are a
few common factors that contribute to stress and anxiety:
1. Major life changes: Significant life events such as moving, getting married (or divorced),
   starting a new job or experiencing the loss of a loved one can trigger it.
2. Work or school pressure: High workloads, tight deadlines, challenging bosses, or work pressure
   can lead to stress and anxiety.
3. Financial challenges: Job loss, debt, or just struggling to make ends meet can be a significant
   source of stress and anxiety.
4. Relationships: Whether romantic, familial or social, strain or conflict in relationships can

## Questions? Answers.

Find quick tips and helpful info about The Mindfulness App and starting your new mindfulness
journey.

Still have questions? Dive deeper in our help center!

[Visit help center][18]

### What is The Mindfulness App?

The Mindfulness App is a comprehensive meditation and wellness platform offering guided meditations,
structured courses, sleep stories, and calming soundscapes — designed to help you build a
sustainable mindfulness practice in just a few minutes a day.

### Is The Mindfulness App good for beginners?

Absolutely. We start you off with a **5-day “Beginner’s Journey”** that teaches the basics
step-by-step. As you progress, you can explore hundreds of sessions for intermediate and advanced
users, so the app grows with your practice.

### Which languages does The Mindfulness App support?

The Mindfulness App’s interface and guided-audio library are fully localised in **English, Swedish,
Norwegian, Danish, German, Spanish, Finnish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Portuguese and
Chinese**.

We’re actively producing new sessions in these and additional languages — check the **Discover › New
& Noteworthy** shelf for fresh drops on a weekly basis.

### Does The Mindfulness App work offline?

Yes. Tap the **Download** icon on any meditation, course, or Sleep Story. Downloads land in your
**Library** under the **Downloads** tab, for easy on-the-go listening without Wi-Fi or data usage.

Your downloads remain available as long as you keep them; there’s **no hard limit**. However, keep
in mind that large libraries will use more storage.

### Does The Mindfulness App offer a free trial?

Yes, every new user receives a **14-day free trial** with full premium access to our content library
of over +500 guided meditations, sleep stories, courses and much more.

You can claim your free trial by [clicking here][19]. and following the checkout steps. Cancel
anytime during the trial, no questions asked.

### What does The Mindfulness App include in a subscription plan?

Your premium subscription unlocks the entire content library — over +500 guided meditations,
immersive sleep stories, themed courses on stress, focus, sleep and resilience, and nature
soundscapes, as well as personalised reminders with streak tracking.

All this seamlessly accessible across iOS, Android and the web — so you have everything you need for
a consistent, flexible mindfulness practice.

## Sign up today and try 14 days for free

Get full access to our premium library with **over +500** meditations, sleep stories and courses for
free!

[Try for free][20]
Start your journey to a more relaxed and healthier state of mind. Whether you are just starting out
or experienced in meditation, we will help you to become more present in your daily life.

# [breathe][9]

## [View Hacking: Shifting Your View of Other People][10]

#### By [Leo Babauta][11]

Let’s imagine a scenario where you are standing in front of everyone, at your own party, surrounded
by friends and family … but you’re afraid of their judgments.

You’re afraid one family member thinks you’re wasting your life, another might think you’re lazy,
another might think you don’t have nice enough clothes, another might think you’re not in good
enough shape. You don’t know that they have these judgments, but you’re afraid they might.

Stressful right? This is why people get social anxiety — we never know what people might be
thinking, how they might be judging us.

I’m going to share something that we’ll call “view hacking” — basically, changing our view of other
people, so that we can have a very different experience, way less stressful.

Let’s dive in.

### **Why We Stress About Other People**

In the scenario I mentioned, what makes it stressful to be in front of all these people you know?

It’s the fear that they’re judging you. The fear of letting others down, of not fitting in, of being
rejected. We don’t know if they’re judging us, but we’re afraid that they are.

So the view that we have is something like: these people are judging me.

It’s possible that’s true, but think about viewing the situation as a minefield for possible
judgment and embarrassment — stressful, right?

The stress comes from this view.

The view that the people might be judging us, that we might be embarrassed, that the whole situation
is dangerous … that’s the view that causes stress.

When we’re frustrated by other people, anxious about them, or having other kinds of problems like
that … the stress comes from the view that we have of them. You might journal about it to try to
uncover the view you have that’s stressing you out. It’s powerful.

### **Shift the View**

Once we’ve identified the view, what can we do about it?

Well, first we should acknowledge that nothing needs to be done. It’s OK to be stressed about,
frustrated by, anxious about other people.

But if we’d like to be less stressed about them, we can shift the view. Come up with a new view that
feels more empowering and less stressful.

Some examples:
* These people love and support me
* I’m grateful to have a connection with this person
* They’re trying their best, and have beautiful hearts
* It would be fun to play with this person!
* If they get upset, it’s a chance for a deeper connection with them

These are just a few examples — can you find a new view that would make you feel less stressed about
people?

Once you have the view, it’s time to practice: write it down, and remind yourself of the new view
whenever you’re feeling that stress. Let yourself really feel the new view, as if it were absolute
truth. And then relate to this person or these people in this new way.

It takes a while to shift the view. But if you are intentional about it, the shift can be profound.

Didn't find the answer to your question?

[Read all FAQs][35]
What product will enable me to have an out-of-body experience?

An OBE cannot be guaranteed. Your ability to experience an OBE depends on many factors unique to
every individual, like personal beliefs, possible fear barriers, etc. If you are interested in an
OBE, we recommend Hemi-Sync® Support for Journeys Out of the Body or the Gateway Experience series.

What’s the difference between Human Plus®, Mind Food®, Heart-Sync® and Metamusic®?

Human Plus recordings teach you how to activate the benefit of a particular selection whenever you
wish without listening at the particular moment when you desire the intended effect. For example,
the Human Plus title, Attention, exercise teaches you how to move into a highly focused state when
not listening to the Attention exercise. Most Mind Food and Heart-Sync titles provide the
experience/benefit while you are listening. For example, the Mind Food title, Concentration, helps
your brain move into a highly focused state of concentration while listening. Metamusic® selections
contain music and Hemi-Sync® with no verbal guidance.

Is there a problem in making copies of Hemi-Sync® products for friends?

Yes. Hemi-Sync® products are copyrighted. You would be breaking federal laws and therefore be liable
to prosecution.

Is Hemi-Sync® recommended for children?

All nonverbal recordings are fine for children. With verbally guided titles, we recommend you listen
first and then decide based on your child’s level of maturity.

Are the Hemi-Sync® frequencies the same on each title?

No. The Hemi-Sync® process has evolved into a sophisticated multi-layering of Hemi-Sync® signals –
“designer mixes” of sound frequencies, fashioned to be optimally effective for a given application.
Naturally, Hemi-Sync® sleep products incorporate predominately delta frequencies; learning products
predominately beta and so forth. However these designer mixes are supplemented with special sound
frequencies, which enable the desired result. This is the “key” to the effectiveness of Hemi-Sync.

## What Is Positivity?

**Positivity** is the quality and practice of being positive — a science-backed orientation toward
what is good, constructive, and hopeful in life. It encompasses optimistic thinking, grateful
awareness, and the intentional cultivation of uplifting emotions like joy, love, gratitude, and
serenity.

Rooted in [positive psychology][73] research by Dr. Martin Seligman and Dr. Barbara Fredrickson,
positivity is not about ignoring problems — it is about building the mental and emotional resources
to face them with resilience. Studies show that people who practice positivity experience **35%

## Frequently Asked Questions

### GENERAL

What is Calm?

Calm is the #1 mental health app designed to help you manage stress, sleep better, and live a
happier, healthier life. Our research-based tools help you build life-changing habits to support
your mental health. If you're having trouble falling asleep, our 500+ [Sleep Stories][3]®,
soundscapes, and guided [sleep meditations][4] can lull you to sleep. If you're spiraling in
negative thoughts and need immediate relief, our 60-second Breathe Bubble grounds you in the moment
and helps your body return to a state of relaxation. If you're overwhelmed at work and need a
breather, our [stress and burnout specialists][5] can guide you through exercises to help calm your
mind. We're here for you whenever or wherever you need us with more content and tools being added
monthly.

What's included in a Calm subscription?

A Calm subscription unlocks our full library of [meditations][6], [Sleep Stories][7], [music][8],
and other features. The subscription includes:
* Multiple original [daily offerings][9] from a range of teachers to give your day a dose of wisdom,
  gratitude and encouragement
* Hours of [guided meditations][10] covering sleep, anxiety, stress, gratitude, and much more
* Our entire library of more than 500+ [Sleep Stories][11], with new stories added every week
* Exclusive [music][12] tracks for focus, relaxation, and sleep

Where should I get started once I download the app?

If you have come to Calm to learn relaxation techniques and improve aspects of your mental health,
we recommend beginning with the [7 Days of Calm][13], our introductory program that offers the
basics of meditation, and then move on to the [21 Days of Calm][14]. With that foundation, you can
explore our library of sessions and programs, which address themes such as [anxiety][15],
[sleep][16], [focus][17], and [gratitude][18]. Additionally, for moments of acute stress or anxiety,
we offer in-the-moment calming exercises via our [Panic SOS][19], [Body Scan][20], and breathing
exercise features.

If you have come to Calm to improve your sleep, we have a collection of over 500 [Sleep Stories][21]
to help you drift off to restful sleep, ranging from [classic literature][22] to [nature
essays][23], [children's tales][24], scientific articles, and more. We update our Sleep Stories
selection with new options to listen to every week. We also have a collection of soothing Sleep
Music.

What devices support the Calm app?

Calm is available on iOS, Android, Web, in addition to Apple TV, Apple Watch, Google WearOS, and
Samsung Health.

### MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS

What is meditation?

Meditation is the practice of allowing thoughts to come and go, as you learn to recognize and
release them without judgment. Studies show that a long-term meditation practice can actually help
shift your nervous system out of fight or flight and into the relaxed parasympathetic mode producing
a wide array of benefits* including:
* Decreased anxiety and depression symptoms
* Chronic pain management
* Lower stress levels
* Improved sleep quality

What is mindfulness?

Mindfulness is a practice that involves intentionally bringing one's attention and awareness to the
present moment without judgment. It's about being fully present and engaged in the here and now,
rather than dwelling on the past or worrying about the future. Mindfulness encourages a
non-judgmental attitude towards one's thoughts, emotions and sensations, allowing them to arise and
pass without any added stress. By cultivating mindfulness, people often develop a greater sense of
clarity, calmness and overall wellbeing, as well as enhance their ability to respond skillfully to
the challenges of life.

### STRESS & ANXIETY

What causes stress and anxiety?

Stress and anxiety can have various causes and can differ greatly from person to person. Here are a
few common factors that contribute to stress and anxiety:
1. Major life changes: Significant life events such as moving, getting married (or divorced),
   starting a new job or experiencing the loss of a loved one can trigger it.
2. Work or school pressure: High workloads, tight deadlines, challenging bosses, or work pressure
   can lead to stress and anxiety.
3. Financial challenges: Job loss, debt, or just struggling to make ends meet can be a significant
   source of stress and anxiety.

## Questions? Answers.

Find quick tips and helpful info about The Mindfulness App and starting your new mindfulness
journey.

Still have questions? Dive deeper in our help center!

[Visit help center][18]

### What is The Mindfulness App?

The Mindfulness App is a comprehensive meditation and wellness platform offering guided meditations,
structured courses, sleep stories, and calming soundscapes — designed to help you build a
sustainable mindfulness practice in just a few minutes a day.

### Is The Mindfulness App good for beginners?

Absolutely. We start you off with a **5-day “Beginner’s Journey”** that teaches the basics
step-by-step. As you progress, you can explore hundreds of sessions for intermediate and advanced
users, so the app grows with your practice.

### Which languages does The Mindfulness App support?

The Mindfulness App’s interface and guided-audio library are fully localised in **English, Swedish,
Norwegian, Danish, German, Spanish, Finnish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Portuguese and
Chinese**.

We’re actively producing new sessions in these and additional languages — check the **Discover › New
& Noteworthy** shelf for fresh drops on a weekly basis.

### Does The Mindfulness App work offline?

Yes. Tap the **Download** icon on any meditation, course, or Sleep Story. Downloads land in your
**Library** under the **Downloads** tab, for easy on-the-go listening without Wi-Fi or data usage.

Your downloads remain available as long as you keep them; there’s **no hard limit**. However, keep
in mind that large libraries will use more storage.

### Does The Mindfulness App offer a free trial?

Yes, every new user receives a **14-day free trial** with full premium access to our content library
of over +500 guided meditations, sleep stories, courses and much more.

You can claim your free trial by [clicking here][19]. and following the checkout steps. Cancel
anytime during the trial, no questions asked.

### What does The Mindfulness App include in a subscription plan?

Your premium subscription unlocks the entire content library — over +500 guided meditations,
immersive sleep stories, themed courses on stress, focus, sleep and resilience, and nature
soundscapes, as well as personalised reminders with streak tracking.

All this seamlessly accessible across iOS, Android and the web — so you have everything you need for
a consistent, flexible mindfulness practice.

## Sign up today and try 14 days for free

Get full access to our premium library with **over +500** meditations, sleep stories and courses for
free!

[Try for free][20]
Start your journey to a more relaxed and healthier state of mind. Whether you are just starting out
or experienced in meditation, we will help you to become more present in your daily life.

## [View Hacking: Shifting Your View of Other People][10]

#### By [Leo Babauta][11]

Let’s imagine a scenario where you are standing in front of everyone, at your own party, surrounded
by friends and family … but you’re afraid of their judgments.

## Sustainable Living.

### ***If times are urgent, let us slow down. ***

**BAYO AKOMOLAFE**

## True wellness is disruption.

While wellness is often translated as “self care,” true wellness is disrupting the idea that we are
separate from the needs and realities of each other. It is also an interruption in the patterns and
systems that keep us distracted, overwhelmed and disconnected from our own wisdom. When things fall
apart, how do we find a felt sense of safety and stability? How do we practice possibility and care
for one another while external conditions are rapidly shifting? 

### ***I believe we hold the possibility to be of service and impact others. That should not come at
### the cost of our own health and nervous system.***

Meditation is a top-down approach, meaning we are using the mind under the function of the cerebral
cortex. Top down processes like meditation, pranayama or talk therapy can help to create capacity,
perspective and clarity with overall thinking and being. While it has a correlating effect on the
body, there are also bottom-up approaches as well to help metabolize the effects of chronic stress
and trauma. Working somatically is utilizing the language of the body to release contractions or
patterned responses. One is not necessarily better than the other. In fact, by utilizing both top
down as well as bottom up approaches, we are giving the body and mind an equal place in an
integrative and holistic process of healing.



### *My mission is to deepen the ways in which we relate to ourselves as well as each other. 
### *

### *I look forward to working with you.*

### About Alchemy Collective

I began Alchemy Collective 10 years ago with the intent of fostering a community for individuals
looking to create change in themselves as well as the world around them. My interests and strengths
lie at the intersection of meditation, somatics, and social change to help others alchemize stress
into expansion, knowledge into action and wellness into collective care.

### About Mark

I am a student of sustainability, decolonization, somatics, and Vedantic philosophy. With decades of
lived experience as an artist, teacher and coach, I know what grind culture and hustle can do to a
nervous system but also have keen insight into the psychology of high performance, creativity and
innovation. Work demands and personal loss left me with PTSD a number of years back which led to
initial studies into Vedic meditation. From there I saw the challenge/opportunity to support
traditional instruction with a practice of embodiment as well as tools for collective care. This was
the catalyst for a decade long journey of inquiry and training to be of service to others and to
foster sustainability in practice.

## *Accountability*

As a cis-white male of privilege, I am committed to disrupting patterns and systems of dominant
culture to bring about more just and equitable chages. To practice collective care starts with
unpacking one's relationship with power and privilege, one’s relationship to self, which is a
lifetime of work. Because I believe in sustainability, 25% of profits from all meditation teaching
is directed towards land regeneration organizations in India and portions of somatic work are
dedicated to supporting organizations dedicated to mental health awareness. And whether facilitating
meditation, somatics or coaching, all courses are taught through the lens of being trauma-informed,
which means you are always in choice and agency throughout the sessions.

* ### [Ananda Marga][108]
  
  Ananda Marga is a global spiritual and social service organization founded in 1955 by [Shrii Shrii
  Anandamurti][109] (Prabhat Ranjan Sarkar). The mission of Ananda Marga is self-realization
  (individual emancipation) and service to humanity (collective welfare): the fulfillment of the
  physical, mental and spiritual needs of all people. Through its meditation centers and service
  projects around the world, Ananda Marga offers instruction in meditation, yoga and other
  self-development practices on a non-commercial basis, and responds to social emergencies and
  long-term social needs. [Read more…][110]
* ### [Self-Realization, Service to All][111]
  
  The ideology of Ananda Marga is Self-Realization and Service to All.
  
  Both aspects are complementary to each other, and both are necessary for a balanced and fulfilling
  life.
  
  The welfare of each and everyone is linked to the welfare of society, and the welfare of society
  depends on the welfare of each and everyone.
  
  [Self-Realization][112]
  
  [Service to All][113]
* ### [Learn Meditation Today][114]
  
  Ananda Marga teaches meditation free of charge all around the world.
  
  Visit our [learn meditation][115] page to learn meditation today!
  
  [[poster]][116]
* ### Ananda Nagar film and photo book
  
  The documentary film [*Ananda Nagar: Land of Bliss*][117] is an overview of the history of Ananda
  Nagar, the pioneering multipurpose rural development scheme and spiritual eco-village of Ananda
  Marga in Rarh, India.
  
  The [photo book][118] *Ananda Nagar: Land of Bliss *is the definitive record of Ananda Nagar,
   tracing its past, present and future. Also available as an [ebook here][119].
* ### Shrii Shrii Anandamurti Centenary
  
  The celebrations for the 100th anniversary of the birth of Shrii Shrii Anandamurti, the guru of
  Ananda Marga, included a documentary film, [exhibition][120] and two [photo books][121], also
  available as [ebooks here][122].

## Individual Transformation for Contemporary People

### Live Online Courses and Individual Sessions

### Time to Turn up for Your Own Life

Find support on your journey of self-discovery at **OSHO International Online (OIO)**. Choose an
individual session or a group activity – a class, a course or a training – all live, online, and
guided by highly trained and experienced facilitators.

Based on Osho’s profound insights into the human condition, and his scientifically developed
methodologies and meditative techniques, your Osho Online experience will expand both your awareness
and your understanding. You will learn skills to help you to thrive in this new and ever-changing
world.

[][35]

offers a multitude of individual sessions relating to the body, the mind, the emotions, or the
subtle energy bodies.

## Welcome

[Vipassana][157], which means to see things as they really are, is one of India's most ancient
techniques of meditation. It was taught in India more than 2500 years ago as a universal remedy for
universal ills, i.e., an [Art of Living][158]. For those who are not familiar with Vipassana
Meditation, an Introduction to Vipassana by Mr. Goenka & related videos and [Questions &
Answers][159] about Vipassana are available.

### Courses

The technique of Vipassana Meditation is taught at ten-day residential courses during which
participants learn the basics of the method, and practice sufficiently to experience its beneficial
results. There are no charges for the courses - not even to cover the cost of food and
accommodation. All expenses are met by donations from people who, having completed a course and
experienced the benefits of Vipassana, wish to give others the opportunity to also benefit.

### Locations

Courses are given in numerous Meditation Centers and at Non-Center course locations at rented sites.

## Welcome

[Vipassana][157], which means to see things as they really are, is one of India's most ancient
techniques of meditation. It was taught in India more than 2500 years ago as a universal remedy for
universal ills, i.e., an [Art of Living][158]. For those who are not familiar with Vipassana
Meditation, an Introduction to Vipassana by Mr. Goenka & related videos and [Questions &
Answers][159] about Vipassana are available.

### Courses

The technique of Vipassana Meditation is taught at ten-day residential courses during which
participants learn the basics of the method, and practice sufficiently to experience its beneficial
results. There are no charges for the courses - not even to cover the cost of food and
accommodation. All expenses are met by donations from people who, having completed a course and
experienced the benefits of Vipassana, wish to give others the opportunity to also benefit.

### Locations

Courses are given in numerous Meditation Centers and at Non-Center course locations at rented sites.
Each location has its own schedule of courses. In most cases, an application for admission to these
courses can be completed online at this website. There are many Vipassana Centers throughout the
world in [India][160] and elsewhere in [Asia/Pacific][161], in [North America][162], in [Latin
America][163], in [Europe][164], in [Australia/New Zealand][165], in the [Middle East][166] and in
[Africa][167]. Ten day non-center courses are frequently held at many locations outside of Centers
as they are arranged by local students of Vipassana in those areas. An [alphabetical list][168] of
worldwide course locations is available as well as a graphical interface of course locations
[worldwide][169] and in [India and Nepal][170].

### Special Courses and Resources

Vipassana Meditation courses are also being taught in [prisons][171]. A special 10-day Vipassana
course especially for business executives and government officials is being held periodically at
several centers around the world. For additional information visit the [Executive Course
Website][172]. Information on Vipassana Meditation is also available in the other languages. Click
on the globe on the top right of the page to select a language.

## A two-minute pause for your nervous system

Do Nothing for 2 Minutes is a simple mindfulness timer for the moments when your mind feels crowded.
No account, no app, no feed, no instructions to optimize yourself. Just ocean waves, a quiet timer,
and two minutes where nothing needs to happen.

Use it between meetings, before starting focused work, after scrolling too long, or whenever you
notice your body asking for a reset. The practice is intentionally small: sit still, breathe
naturally, and let your hands leave the keyboard and mouse alone.

If you move, the timer starts again. Not as punishment, but as a gentle reminder that rest works
best when it is actually uninterrupted.

Two minutes will not solve everything. But it can create a little space before the next thing.

## Not like other meditation apps

immersed in  Icelandic nature.

Meditation guidance in English and Icelandic, suitable for everyone from beginner to seasoned
expert. Styles ranging from calming stillness to intuitive movement.

as Ólafur Arnalds, Sigur Rós, and Of Monsters and Men, straight into your Flow apps.

Let the sound of water, waves, and wind wash all your worries away.  Listen to the birds sing or

Build sessions from 4- and 8-minute meditations that are easy to fit into your day-to-day life.

## Meet Fab – The Heart Behind Flow Wellness

With over two decades of experience in nursing, holistic therapies and meditation, Fab brings a
calm, compassionate presence to everyone she works with. Her own journey through healing and
transformation is what inspires the work we do at Flow Wellness Centre today.

Discover her story and the vision behind Flow.

[ ABOUT US ][36]

## What she offers

### Holistic Therapy (Reiki + Energy Work)

A restorative experience for body, mind and energy.
**Feel**
You’ve been feeling off — energetically, emotionally or physically.
You might not be able to name it, but you know something is out of balance. This is a space to feel
held, heard and realigned.
**Flow**
Each session is tailored to what you need that day — drawing from Reiki, grounding practices,
intuitive healing, emotional release and calming nervous system techniques.
You’ll lie down fully clothed and simply receive.
**Grow**
Most clients leave feeling lighter, clearer and reconnected with themselves.
It’s more than just “feeling better” — it’s about restoring your inner flow so that your body, mind
and energy can work in harmony again.

[ BOOK A SESSION ][37]

### Group Meditation (weekly sessions)

For those who need a moment to exhale — and don’t want to do it alone.
**Feel**
You’re tired of rushing. You’re craving presence, but it’s hard to slow down by yourself.
You want space to breathe, reflect, and reconnect — gently and without pressure.
**Flow**
These sessions offer a calm, welcoming space.
We begin with a short reflection, then I’ll guide you through a gentle meditation (no silence or
awkwardness). We often finish with tea, journaling, or light conversation. Get connected with
like-minded people.
No experience needed — just come as you are.
**Grow**
Leave feeling lighter, clearer, and more grounded.
You’ll build emotional resilience, inner calm, and real connection — both with yourself and the
group.
This isn’t just meditation. It’s a reset for your nervous system and your week.

[ BOOK A SESSION ][38]

### Corporate Wellness Programs

Stress-reduction and performance support for modern teams.

**Mindful Reset Session™**
A 30-minute experience to shift mindset, release pressure, and spark clarity.

**The Resilient Mind Method™**
A 10-week evidence-informed program that supports calm focus, emotional regulation, and better
decision-making.

[ VIEW PROGRAM ][39]

### Spiritual/ Holistic Mentoring for Mums

You hold everything together — this is space for someone to hold you.
**Intention**
To support you emotionally, mentally and spiritually in the real experience of motherhood — beyond
the to-do list.
You don’t need to be fixed. You just need a space to be seen, supported and reminded of your
strength.
**Journey**
Each session is tailored to your needs: we explore emotional burnout, the invisible load, identity
shifts, self-compassion, nervous system regulation and more.
This isn’t coaching or therapy — it’s grounded support for your heart, body and mind.

# Meditation und Achtsamkeit mit Hannes Huber

 

 

**Vipassana Retreats 2025/26** siehe [hier][5]

**Metta Retreat 2026** siehe [hier][6]

 

 


 

 

 

 

Als ich jung war, las ich viele Bücher über Entdecker und war sehr enttäuscht, dass keine
unentdeckten Plätze mehr übrig waren.

Seitdem ich die psychologische Welt entdeckt habe, weiß ich, dass das eine Welt der Wildnis ist, die
schon von vielen erforscht wurde. Viele aber kehren in unsere Welt zurück, ohne richtige Instrumente
mitzubringen und gehen verloren.

Ich habe das beste Instrument - Achtsamkeit.

  *Sayadaw U Jotika*

 

 

Den Dingen geht der Geist voran, der Geist entscheidet: Kommt aus getrübtem Geist dein Wort und
deine Taten, so folgt dir Leiden - wie dem Zugtier folgt der Wagen.

Den Dingen geht der Geist voran, der Geist entscheidet: Entspringem klarem Geist dein Wort und deine
Taten, folgt das Glück dir nach - wie auf Schritt und Tritt dein Schatten.

*Dhammapada*

## [Sai Baba iš Širdžio (1838-1918). Biografija][48]


Sai Nath arba Sai Baba iš Širdžio mažai žinomas Vakaruose, tačiau apie jį žino praktiškai visa
Indija. Kalba eina apie didingą Indijos šventąjį, stebukladarį ir dvasinį mokytoją, gyvenusį daugiau
nei prieš šimtą metų Maharaštroje, kuris padėjo pamatus indų ir musulmonų vienovei Šiaurės ir
Centrinėje Indijoje.

Sai Nath buvo tikras Dvasinis Mokytojas (Guru), tai yra Sad Guru. Jo didingumo neišeina aprašyti.
Jeigu kažkas ateidavo pas jį į daršaną, tai jis galėjo be jokių prašymų atverti tam žmogui jo
praeitį, dabartį ir ateitį. Jis matė Dievą visose būtybėse. Su draugais ir priešais jis elgėsi
vienodai. Nei sėkmė, nei nemalonumai neišvesdavo jo iš pusiausvyros. Jis iš nieko nelaukė dėkingumo
ir laimino visus. Jis neturėjo nei abejonių, nei baimių.… [skaityti daugiau][49]

## Frequently asked questions

Didn't find the answer to your question?

[Read all FAQs][35]
What product will enable me to have an out-of-body experience?

An OBE cannot be guaranteed. Your ability to experience an OBE depends on many factors unique to
every individual, like personal beliefs, possible fear barriers, etc. If you are interested in an
OBE, we recommend Hemi-Sync® Support for Journeys Out of the Body or the Gateway Experience series.

What’s the difference between Human Plus®, Mind Food®, Heart-Sync® and Metamusic®?

Human Plus recordings teach you how to activate the benefit of a particular selection whenever you
wish without listening at the particular moment when you desire the intended effect. For example,
the Human Plus title, Attention, exercise teaches you how to move into a highly focused state when
not listening to the Attention exercise. Most Mind Food and Heart-Sync titles provide the
experience/benefit while you are listening. For example, the Mind Food title, Concentration, helps
your brain move into a highly focused state of concentration while listening. Metamusic® selections
contain music and Hemi-Sync® with no verbal guidance.

Is there a problem in making copies of Hemi-Sync® products for friends?

Yes. Hemi-Sync® products are copyrighted. You would be breaking federal laws and therefore be liable
to prosecution.

Is Hemi-Sync® recommended for children?

All nonverbal recordings are fine for children. With verbally guided titles, we recommend you listen
first and then decide based on your child’s level of maturity.

Are the Hemi-Sync® frequencies the same on each title?

No. The Hemi-Sync® process has evolved into a sophisticated multi-layering of Hemi-Sync® signals –
“designer mixes” of sound frequencies, fashioned to be optimally effective for a given application.
Naturally, Hemi-Sync® sleep products incorporate predominately delta frequencies; learning products
predominately beta and so forth. However these designer mixes are supplemented with special sound
frequencies, which enable the desired result. This is the “key” to the effectiveness of Hemi-Sync.

# TALKS

### **OPEN WIDE AND SAY AWE**

"On April 15, 2012, I was flying home from a conference. And on the first leg of my trip, somewhere
between Tucson and Las Vegas, I died." Join Katherine as she explores the wild and magical terrain
of death, psychedelics and healing, from the clinic at Johns Hopkins to her sister's hospital room
and beyond.

### BEFRIENDING THE MYSTERY

Psychedelics have officially re-entered mainstream consciousness, through clinical research trials
at major universities, corporate-sponsored pharmaceutical drug development, and decriminalization
efforts in major America cities. Everyone from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to Michael Pollan now has a
story to tell about how mushrooms can save humanity. But let's not forget the original love stories
that the mushrooms have been quietly sharing with humans for millennia. In this talk, Dr. Katherine
MacLean weaves a tale of scientific discovery, mystical love, super-natural intelligence, and
personal redemption from the perspective of individual humans and their amazing encounters with
psilocybin mushrooms.

### THE PSYCHEDELIC ART OF DYING

You only have a few days left to live. How would you want to live? How would you want to die?

## Hi, I'm

[giovanni name in brush]

I’m an author, certified meditation teacher, coach and speaker. With over 9,000 hours of meditation,
and a diverse training in different traditions, my teaching style is pragmatic, simple, methodical,
and non-sectarian.

My personal anthem—and the transformation I facilitate—is **Empowered Peace**. This is the reality I
live in now.

But I was *not* born peaceful. As a teenager I was restless. My mind was always busy, and never
content. I was easily disturbed, and would often overreact when triggered. I also struggled with
being bullied.

Things started to change when I found meditation—and all its wisdom teachings—as a 15-year old.
Meditation taught me that the real bully is inside my head, and that I can learn to be my own best
friend. It taught me how to let go, be greater than my problems, and accept myself.

LiveAndDare exists so that you too can be **calm, centered, focused** — and experience empowered
peace.

This is my purpose. Will you join me?

* ## Let the Plan of Love and Light work out

### Lucis Trust

*Lucis* is a form of the Latin word, lux, and means ‘*Light*’

The Lucis Trust is dedicated to the establishment of a new and better way of life for everyone in
the world based on the fulfillment of the divine plan for humanity. Its educational activities
promote recognition and practice of the spiritual principles and values upon which a stable and
interdependent world society may be based. The esoteric philosophy of its founder, Alice Bailey,
informs its activities which are offered freely throughout the world in eight languages.

# Learning Meditation

### Introduction to Meditation

Meditation is the art of looking inside and discovering one’s own inner being. Meditation leads us
not only to totally new inner experiences, but helps us also to transform our day-to-day life into a
better, more meaningful and more fulfilling existence.
* [What is Meditation?][19]

 

### Meditation Exercises

Meditation is something we experience ourself. Reading about meditation is not sufficient, we need
to practise and learn the art of meditation. This site offers a few simple meditation and
concentration exercises.
* [Meditation exercises][20]

 

### Benefits of Meditation

There is increasing interest in the various benefits of meditation. Many studies have shown regular
meditation can help alleviate symptoms of stress and aid physical health. Meditation can also give
many other benefits.
* [Benefits of Meditation][21]

 

### Questions about Meditation

Some Questions and Answers about Meditation. Including tips on how to silence the mind and overcome
common difficulties.
* [Questions and Answers][22]

 

### Learn To Meditate

Some of the practical guidelines for learning meditation and making it part of your daily practise.
Also information about Sri Chinmoy Centres who offer free meditation classes in different parts of
the world.
* [Learn to Meditate][23]

 

### Meditation Blog

Some articles and tips on meditation.
* [Meditation Blog][24]

 

### Meditation Teachers

There are many different paths of meditation. The goal of meditation is the same, but, there are
different ways to realise the goal of meditation. These are a small selection of the many Spiritual
teachers who have taught methods of meditation:
* [Meditation teachers][25]

## Health Begins In The Mind

### Never had conversations this deep

I felt guided through the sessions and the routes of conversation we were taking. Each direction
taken was explained clearly and easy to understand.

Sandy

### Loved speaking with you

Spent a sessions discovering my ‘why?’ to get to the root cause of a problem rather than just
addressing a solution. Using this method really helped guide an understanding of how I think and
behave.

Lucy

### Thank you

I learnt that I give too much importance to external validation. Prabhmeet was able to show me this
but also show me how I can take control and keep trying me best.

Francis

### Where did you get your knowledge from!

I am very satisfied with my coaching experience as it has unlocked knowledge about myself that I
would not have been able to gain on my own.

Cynthia

### Thank you for bringing self-awareness

As a Senior Manager it was great to understand the subject of Promotion from a different angle and
point of view. You have been able to personalise the matter to my needs while managing to approach
the topic in an unbiased way.

Salmaan

### Appreciate the insights on my management style

Prabhmeet provided great workshop. He helped me develop my understanding of my potential management
style which will benefit me in a leadership role.

James

### You’ve helped me to understand perspective

Prabhmeet was able to help me demystify the way that I measure success, having a dim view of the
corporate world. He showed me the power of perspective and I feel a massivly uplifted through
further understanding myself.

Sheree

### Thank you!

Wanted to reach out and extend a big thank you from everyone who was lucky enough to attend out
‘Fireside chat’ with you yesterday. The engagement and interest from the room audience was
remarkable and the feedback has been incredibly positive!

Alison

### Feel uplifted

Thank you for the workshop at our office with the EMEA Mangement team. Many folks commented on how
they left the room feeling uplifted and hopeful – and many enlightened – they had truly learnt
something new that would add value to their lives.

Hugh

### Would love to continue the conversation!

It was both a priviledge and a treat to sit on the sofa with you, I especially enjoyed watching the
audience themsleves – after an initial surprise (it was a different type of conversation than we
have had before) they became totally engrossed in what you were saying! Would love to have you back
again to continue the conversation we have started!

James

### Lightbulb moments!

I spotted ‘light bulb’ moments going off here and there during the talk. So lovely for you to come
and host a session with us.

Samantha

### Thanks for the workshop

Thanks also for making the time after your workshop to speak to some audience members. I was able to
hover over and I could see you had given the time for those who were a little more shy to ask
questions on a 1-2-1 basis, very kind of you. Would welcome you back anytime for further sessions –
perhaps Mental Health Day in October?

Sara

**Corporate**

Prabhmeet offers right-mindfulness and meditation workshops tailored to meet the unique needs of
businesses across various sectors, helping teams reduce stress, enhance focus, and cultivate a
culture of wellbeing.

Working with Global companies, Prabhmeet has delivered workshops and talks ranging from a group of 6
people to 1,800 people. Audience members have spanned from  the UK, North Amercia, European
countries, Singapore and Australia.

**Personal**

Prabhmeet provides 1-2-1 psycho-spiritual therapy sessions, where he works together with you to
explore your personal challenges and unlock your full potential. As a Certified Coach, Prabhmeet
brings a holistic approach that combines goal-setting with emotional growth, ensuring that your
personal and professional development aligns with your inner values and purpose.

For those looking to deepen their practice, Prabhmeet runs an 8-week Mindfulness-Based Stress
Reduction (MBSR) course. This structured program is designed to reduce stress, increase resilience,
and foster a deeper sense of mindfulness and presence in daily life. Offered in Groups of up to six
people therefore allowing the power of ‘sangat’ or socialising ideas to drive individual change.

Whether you’re looking to enhance individual or team performance, improve wellbeing, or navigate
personal challenges, Prabhmeet can help you build a more mindful, focused, and resilient way of
living.

**Qualifications**
* Master’s in Transpersonal Psychology with a focus on Mindfulness Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT)
  and Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction (MBSR)

[The OSHO Sammasati Logo]

The aim of OSHO Sammasati is to provide meditative support and other resources for every dimension
of living – in health, in illness and in dying.

#### To learn to meditate

[Meditation][Meditation]If you are new to meditation, our [Meditation][86] section provides an
introduction to what meditation is (and isn’t); how to ‘do’ it; tips for the beginner (and for the
more experienced); how to choose a method and benefits of meditation.

 

[Meditation Toolkit][Meditation Toolkit]Our [Meditation Toolkit][87] provides a wealth of meditation
methods and meditation resources including guidance (some from [Osho][88]) about meditating during
different phases of life – in health & ageing, in illness & pain, in dying or bereavement and in
caring for someone who is seriously ill or dying. We also give suggestions of how to guide someone
else in meditation and look at how meditation can be used as a window into dying, thereby making it
easier for us to deal with. Audio products, details of meditation workshops and articles on
meditation can also be found in the toolkit.

Our [Index of Meditations][89] can be searched by feature (e.g. time of day) and by subject (e.g.
health, pain, dying) or you can choose to practice our [Meditation of the Day][90].

## What Is Positivity?

**Positivity** is the quality and practice of being positive — a science-backed orientation toward
what is good, constructive, and hopeful in life. It encompasses optimistic thinking, grateful
awareness, and the intentional cultivation of uplifting emotions like joy, love, gratitude, and
serenity.

Rooted in [positive psychology][73] research by Dr. Martin Seligman and Dr. Barbara Fredrickson,
positivity is not about ignoring problems — it is about building the mental and emotional resources
to face them with resilience. Studies show that people who practice positivity experience **35%
lower heart disease risk**, **stronger immune function**, and **greater life satisfaction**.

At **Positivity.org**, we provide free, evidence-based tools to help you practice positivity daily:
[750+ affirmations][74], [20+ guided meditation scripts][75], [inspirational quotes][76],
interactive [wellness tools][77], and in-depth articles on mindfulness, habits, and emotional
growth.

Whether you are starting your day with a [daily affirmation][78], exploring the [growth
mindset][79], or finding calm through [guided meditation][80] — every small step toward positivity
creates lasting change in your brain, body, and relationships.

## ABOUT US

### ABOUT PREKSHA MEDITATION

## A journey to your
## inner consciousness

Preksha Meditation is the combination of knowledge from our ancient religious books, modern science
and our experience. Preksha Meditation is the practice of purifying our emotions and our conscious
(chitta) and realizing our own self. Preksha Meditation is a technique of mediation for attitudinal
change, behavioral modification and integrated development of personality.

Successful camps and seminars of national and international level have been organized to inculcate
the techniques of this unique method called Preksha Meditation. More than 550,000 people around the
world, with different cultural backgrounds and religions, have benefited from regularly practicing
it. Amongst them are people from all walks of life.

### Origins & Legacy

Rooted in Jain philosophy yet designed for universal applicability—beyond any religious boundaries.
Combines spiritual wisdom with scientific understanding for inner transformation.

### See Yourself Through Yourself

Preksha encourages pure self-awareness and internal observation.Based on purification of emotions,
restructuring of habits, and cultivating mindfulness.

and our experience. Preksha Meditation is the practice of purifying our emotions and our conscious
(chitta) and realizing our own self. Preksha Meditation is a technique of mediation for attitudinal
change, behavioral modification and integrated development of personality.

Successful camps and seminars of national and international level have been organized to inculcate
the techniques of this unique method called Preksha Meditation. More than 550,000 people around the
world, with different cultural backgrounds and religions, have benefited from regularly practicing
it. Amongst them are people from all walks of life.

### Origins & Legacy

Rooted in Jain philosophy yet designed for universal applicability—beyond any religious boundaries.
Combines spiritual wisdom with scientific understanding for inner transformation.

Preksha encourages pure self-awareness and internal observation.Based on purification of emotions,
restructuring of habits, and cultivating mindfulness.

iRest is a simple and accessible form of meditation designed for modern day living. Backed by

Your body and mind know how to fall into deep and nourishing sleep. iRest gives you simple tools to
revive these natural abilities, improving your capacity for sleep and enhancing the quality of the
sleep you get.

[Try iRest Now][87]

more restful sleep throughout the night. If you wake during the night, following the steps of iRest
can induce the deep relaxation needed to get back to sleep. During the day, iRest ‘naps’ of only 10
or 20 minutes can help you fall into short periods of restful sleep, so you awaken refreshed and
ready for the rest of your day.

those using other methods. Whether insomnia or sleep deprivation are the result of life’s daily
demands, shift work, parenting young children, health problems, anxiety, trauma, or any other
condition, iRest can help.

# Restore Peace with iRest

With iRest, you will discover that you have an indestructible inner resource of strength, calm and

**How does iRest resolve trauma?**

iRest is an evidence-based form of guided meditation that has been shown to resolve symptoms
associated with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). The simple steps of iRest (which have been
tested in clinical trials) calm the nervous system, release stress, increase resiliency and restore
a sense of balance and control.

iRest is easy to learn and can be practiced by anyone. Even short practices of 10 or 20 minutes can
bring about a sense of calm and ease and the ability to face difficult or stressful situations.

There are currently iRest programs in active duty military and Veteran’s Health Administration
medical facilities across the United States, as well as in correctional facilities, hospices,
homeless shelters, clinics and schools around the globe. Based on current studies with iRest in the
military and veteran community, the Defense Centers of Excellence for Psychological Health and
Traumatic Brain Injury recognizes iRest as a Complementary and Alternative Medicine warranting
continuing research for its use in the treatment of post-traumatic stress.

[Meditate 7 days a week]
 

Space2Meditate offers the opportunity to sit on-line with the support of community [**7 days a
week**][54]. Wild, right? We can do this thanks to a wonderful [team][55] of teachers and
volunteers, and the incredible support of our community. We also host residential retreats and a
range of other events and gatherings.

**We invite you to join us and to get to know us. **You will discover that we like poetry (a lot),
coffee (also a lot), keeping it real and a good laugh now and again. Cause it’s rough out there.

**Our practice style?** We don’t avoid the headlines. Instead, we work with what is happening in the
world right here, in the crucible of meditation and community. Together, we try to metabolize what
the heck is going on, the macro, the micro, and everything in between.

**Give yourself Space2Meditate.**

[ Join Us ][56]
 
[
][57]

Practice contemplative living from home — with guided meditations, Dharma teachings, and community
support.
Flexible to fit your real life.
Join live or follow along with daily recordings.
Open to all levels.
Offered on the basis of generosity.

## [Join us][59].

### **Stop, Drop, Sit and *Connect***

Silent meditation 7am EST 7days/week
Guided meditation 8am EST 7days/week
BIPOC Community Sit 2X month on Sat 8:45am
Monthly Dharma Nights - 2nd Sundays 7pm EST
Monthly Sangha Nights - 4th Sundays 7pm EST
And a bunch of other cool resources and wonderful humans

[ See the full schedule ][60]
 

We’re chill. We don’t take attendance! Some folks come every day, others drop in from time to time,
and everything in between. It’s all good.

There is a core group that is quite steady and will always delight in seeing new and returning
faces.

Some folks just want to meditate. Others like to also connect with one another. No pressure either
way. Engage in a way that works for you.

**How does it all work? We operate on the basis of gift economics. **

Everything we do is fueled by the generosity of community.

No one is turned away for lack of funds.

with either of them to check-in about your practice, meditation, and how you might be working to

* #### About Upayadhi
  
  My journey in the Dharma began in 2004 at the London Buddhist Centre in Bethnal Green. Since
  stumbling onto my first meditation cushion, I've trained across a range of Buddhist traditions,
  but I remain rooted in the Triratna Buddhist Order, to which I was ordained in 2018.
  
  My professional background is in leadership development, executive education, and coaching. The
  2016 elections were a turning point — I entered Union Theological Seminary in New York, where I
  studied Buddhism and Inter-religious Engagement. I'm currently pursuing doctoral work in Religious
  Studies at the University of Chicago Divinity School.
  
  I co-founded Awareness is Revolutionary, a collective cultivating Beloved Community and racial
  literacy within a Dharmic framework. I'm also a certified MBSR teacher and have practiced as an
  interfaith chaplain in hospice and hospital settings. When the pandemic hit, Jon Aaron and I
  co-founded Space2Meditate.
  
  I was born and raised in France, and am of Italian heritage. My name is a reference to the
  qualities of wisdom (dhi) and compassion in action (upaya) in the Buddhist tradition.
  
  You can find out more about me and my training pathway on my personal website.
* #### Stuff we might talk about…
  
  My zig-zag of a life has taken quite a few 180-degree turns — which makes me a good conversation
  partner for anyone living with paradox or standing at some kind of crossroads. I'm a Third Culture
  Kid, a Buddhist chaplain, a mindfulness-based coach, a recovering corporate executive, and a queer
  white woman doing anti-racism work in Buddhist spaces. Also: a card-carrying nerd addicted to
  learning (currently in grad school for the third time), and a deep introvert who genuinely wants
  to connect but needs a little coaxing out from under her rock. (That's your cue — book a chat.)
  
  Here's the kind of territory I love exploring with people: meditation and Dharma practice;
  belonging and identity; big scary life transitions; messy race, sexuality, and gender stuff; and
  the group dynamics and intercultural misreads that drive us nuts. We might go deep on what
  collective liberation actually feels/looks like; what healing really takes; how to survive
  late-stage capitalism with your heart somewhat intact; or why pleasure is crucial for resistance.
  Theological rabbit holes? Career and what-do-I-do-with-my-life conundrums? Difficult communication
  with loved ones, and lesser loved ones? Existential dread at 2am? All welcome. I'm here for it.
  Let's talk.

The Santa Cruz Meditation Group of Self-Realization Fellowship was formed in 1977 with the purpose
of bringing spiritual seekers together to promote their spiritual growth through group meditation
and spiritual fellowship. We welcome all to a sanctuary of peace with which to help balance
meditation and activity in our daily lives and to share and practice the teachings of Paramahansa
Yogananda. 

## [SELF-REALIZATION FELLOWSHIP][19]

Through its world wide service and teachings, SRF seeks to awaken greater understanding of the
harmony underlying all religions, and fuller expression of the love that unites all people when they
realize their oneness in God.

 

 

## [MEDITATION][20]


*"To commune daily with God in deep meditation and to carry His love and guidance with you into all
your dutiful activities, is the way that leads to permanent peace and happiness." *
*--* Paramahansa Yogananda

 

 

[Contact the Santa Cruz Meditation Group][21]

## [SERVICES][22]


*“Group meditation is a castle that protects the new spiritual aspirants as well as the veteran
meditators. Meditating together increases the degree of self-realization of each member of the group
by the law of invisible vibratory exchange of group magnetism.” 
  *– Paramahansa Yogananda

## Mingyur Rinpoche

Yongey  Mingyur Rinpoche is a teacher, best-selling author, and the guiding teacher of the worldwide
Tergar Meditation Community. He possesses a rare ability to present the ancient wisdom of Tibet in a
fresh, engaging manner. His profound yet accessible teachings and playful sense of humor have
endeared him to students around the world. Most uniquely, Rinpoche’s teachings weave together his
own personal experiences with modern scientific research, relating both to the practice of
meditation.

#### The Primordial Secret: Dzogchen Teachings on Resting in the Natural State

***August 15–17, 2026***

In this opening retreat of Tergar’s new year-long Dzogchen transmission, Mingyur Rinpoche will
transmit the crucial first sections of the *Heart Essence of the Primordial Secret* instruction
manual.

[ Learn More & Register → ][133]

#### New Course: Voices of Dzogchen

***August 1–26, 2026***

Voices of Dzogchen offers live webinars with prominent Buddhist teachers who embody the Dzogchen
tradition: Mingyur Rinpoche, Erik Pema Kunsang, Richard Barron (Lama Chökyi Nyima), and Sangye
Khandro.

[ Learn More & Join → ][134]

#### Fearless Wisdom: An Introduction to Dzogchen

***August 1, 2026***

The path of Dzogchen — the “Great Perfection” — reveals that the wisdom we seek is already within
us, hidden only by a subtle oversight. On August 1, Mingyur Rinpoche leads a **free webinar** to
launch a year-long transmission of instructions drawn from the Dzogchen text *The Heart Essence of
the Primordial Secret*. Join us to get a roadmap for this transformative year of study and practice
to discover fearless wisdom.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Why do I need a teacher? Can’t I learn this on my own?

Having a certified teacher guide you in a personal, one-on-one setting ensures: 
* You’re accurately and effectively learning the Transcendental Meditation technique
* You have the chance to talk through the new experiences that come up
* Establishes the foundation for a lifelong support system

How do you actually do TM? What happens during Transcendental Meditation?

TM is practiced sitting comfortably, with your eyes closed, for 20 minutes, twice a day. During the
practice, your mind naturally settles inward into quieter levels of awareness, without asking you to
concentrate or control anything. The result is pure consciousness—a unique state of deep rest that
helps the body and mind reset.

Is TM similar to other mantra meditations? What is a TM mantra?

Your Transcendental Meditation mantra is a specific sound chosen for you personally by your TM
Teacher. Unlike affirmations or other phrases rooted in meaning, your TM mantra isn’t meant to keep
your mind active or focused. Instead, it’s an important part of the technique that helps the mind
settle inward naturally and effortlessly.

What does “transcending” mean?

Scientists have studied what happens to the brain during Transcendental Meditation, and it’s called
“transcending”. It’s when your mind and body settle inward into a quiet, deeply restful state, while
you’re still fully awake. There’s no concentration or effort required on your part—it all happens
automatically through the TM technique.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Why do I need a teacher? Can’t I learn this on my own?

Having a certified teacher guide you in a personal, one-on-one setting ensures: 
* You’re accurately and effectively learning the Transcendental Meditation technique
* You have the chance to talk through the new experiences that come up
* Establishes the foundation for a lifelong support system

How do you actually do TM? What happens during Transcendental Meditation?

TM is practiced sitting comfortably, with your eyes closed, for 20 minutes, twice a day. During the
practice, your mind naturally settles inward into quieter levels of awareness, without asking you to
concentrate or control anything. The result is pure consciousness—a unique state of deep rest that
helps the body and mind reset.

Is TM similar to other mantra meditations? What is a TM mantra?

Your Transcendental Meditation mantra is a specific sound chosen for you personally by your TM
Teacher. Unlike affirmations or other phrases rooted in meaning, your TM mantra isn’t meant to keep
your mind active or focused. Instead, it’s an important part of the technique that helps the mind
settle inward naturally and effortlessly.

What does “transcending” mean?

Scientists have studied what happens to the brain during Transcendental Meditation, and it’s called
“transcending”. It’s when your mind and body settle inward into a quiet, deeply restful state, while
you’re still fully awake. There’s no concentration or effort required on your part—it all happens
automatically through the TM technique. 

Throughout this process, the nervous system begins to reset, which is what leads to many of the
benefits people notice from TM, like less stress, clearer thinking, and greater overall balance. And
when you do this day after day, these benefits keep growing.

What if I'm not good at controlling my mind?

That’s completely okay, and actually very common. Especially because the Transcendental Meditation
technique doesn’t ask you to control your mind, nor does it require any concentration or effort. The
technique works naturally, even for people who feel like their mind never slows down.

What if I'm skeptical?

No worries, a lot of people are at first. The good news is Transcendental Meditation doesn’t depend
on any religion, philosophy, or belief system to work. In fact, you don’t need to change your
lifestyle at all. The technique works naturally by allowing the mind and nervous system to settle
into a deeply restful state, regardless of whether or not you have doubts.

Can beginners really do it?

Absolutely! Transcendental Meditation is designed to be effortless to learn and practice, even if
you’ve never meditated before. Children as young as 10 years old learn the technique successfully,
because transcending is something the mind naturally knows how to do.

Is it safe for anxiety, depression, or trauma?

Transcendental Meditation is a gentle, natural technique that helps regulate the nervous system and
create deep rest. Many therapists and healthcare professionals recommend it as a complement to other
forms of support and treatment, and it’s the only meditation practice ever referenced in American
Heart Association guidelines.

Can I do it anywhere?

Anywhere you can sit comfortably with your eyes closed, you can practice Transcendental Meditation.
People practice sitting up in bed, riding on the bus, on an airplane, or in a comfortable chair at
home. TM is designed to fit into your day, not interrupt it.

#### Welcome to Vipassana Fellowship

"The Buddha taught Dhamma to his followers out of compassion, he taught them Dhamma for their
benefit and happiness. When they had listened to the Dhamma they could ponder over it and put it
into practice. The Buddha taught about the ill effects of anger. Anger leads to different kinds of
suffering for the person who is angry, but the person to whom anger is directed does not have to
suffer from it if he does not have anger himself."

- Khun Sujin Boriharnwanaket

#### [Meditation Course][8]

The online [meditation course][9] has been hosted here since 1997. Our 10 week course provides a
clear and practical introduction to tranquillity and insight practices originating in the Theravada
tradition of Buddhism but beneficial to all.

#### [Authentic Texts][10]

All of the documents on this site take their lead from the [Pali Canon][11]; the most authoritative
record and guide to the historical Buddha's teachings. They are part of a living spiritual tradition
that continues to flourish after two and a half millennia. These documents provide contextual
background for our meditation practice.

#### [Useful Resources][12]

We are an independent site promoting a balanced approach to the practice of meditation. We aim to
offer [resources][13] to help nurture and sustain a fulfilling and effective meditation practice.

#### [Authoritative Teachings][14]

In addition to presenting the core texts of early Buddhism we are developing an online library
featuring some of the finest modern writing on [meditation][15].

#### [Stay Informed][16]

Our [newsletter][17] contains details of our new courses and items of interest to those meditating
in the vipassana and samatha traditions.

What is vipassana?

In the Pali language of the early Buddhist texts, vipassana means insight. It is often used to
describe one of the two main categories of Buddhist meditation (the other being samatha or
tranquillity).

What is Theravada Buddhism?

The southern form of Buddhism now found mainly in Thailand, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar. It is the oldest
living tradition and its core teachings are based on the word of the Buddha as found in the earliest
texts.

Are your courses only for Buddhists?

Definitely not! Most of our participants are not Buddhist. We always have a wide range of people of
many different faiths (and of no faith) on our courses. We explain the context in which these
particular meditation practices developed but our aim is to help people to learn to meditate, in a
clear and systematic way, to see if it is useful in their lives - whatever their existing beliefs.

#### Welcome to Vipassana Fellowship

"The Buddha taught Dhamma to his followers out of compassion, he taught them Dhamma for their
benefit and happiness. When they had listened to the Dhamma they could ponder over it and put it
into practice. The Buddha taught about the ill effects of anger. Anger leads to different kinds of
suffering for the person who is angry, but the person to whom anger is directed does not have to
suffer from it if he does not have anger himself."

- Khun Sujin Boriharnwanaket

#### [Meditation Course][8]

The online [meditation course][9] has been hosted here since 1997. Our 10 week course provides a
clear and practical introduction to tranquillity and insight practices originating in the Theravada
tradition of Buddhism but beneficial to all.

#### [Authentic Texts][10]

All of the documents on this site take their lead from the [Pali Canon][11]; the most authoritative
record and guide to the historical Buddha's teachings. They are part of a living spiritual tradition
that continues to flourish after two and a half millennia. These documents provide contextual
background for our meditation practice.

#### [Useful Resources][12]

We are an independent site promoting a balanced approach to the practice of meditation. We aim to
offer [resources][13] to help nurture and sustain a fulfilling and effective meditation practice.

#### [Authoritative Teachings][14]

In addition to presenting the core texts of early Buddhism we are developing an online library
featuring some of the finest modern writing on [meditation][15].

#### [Stay Informed][16]

Our [newsletter][17] contains details of our new courses and items of interest to those meditating
in the vipassana and samatha traditions.

What is vipassana?

In the Pali language of the early Buddhist texts, vipassana means insight. It is often used to
describe one of the two main categories of Buddhist meditation (the other being samatha or
tranquillity).

What is Theravada Buddhism?

The southern form of Buddhism now found mainly in Thailand, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar. It is the oldest
living tradition and its core teachings are based on the word of the Buddha as found in the earliest
texts.

Are your courses only for Buddhists?

Definitely not! Most of our participants are not Buddhist. We always have a wide range of people of
many different faiths (and of no faith) on our courses. We explain the context in which these
particular meditation practices developed but our aim is to help people to learn to meditate, in a
clear and systematic way, to see if it is useful in their lives - whatever their existing beliefs.

###### Expert Guidance

## Grounded in Authentic Wisdom

[Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, Himalayan Institute Spiritual Head]

Vishoka Meditation is grounded in the authentic wisdom of ancient, yet living, tradition embodied by
luminaries including Buddha, Patanjali, and a long line of Siddha masters. Drawing upon both yoga
and tantra, Vishoka Meditation shares the essence of ancient source texts including the Yoga Sutra,
Lotus Sutra, and Shiva Sutra.

Passed down for thousands of years, the practice of Vishoka Meditation was distilled for the
21st-century practitioner by Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, Ph.D., a modern-day master and spiritual head
of the Himalayan Institute.

[Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, PhD]

### Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, PhD

Spiritual Head at Himalayan Institue

#### [ Read Teacher Bio ][21]

Pandit Rajmani Tigunait, Ph.D., is a modern-day master and living link in the unbroken Himalayan
Tradition. He is the successor to Sri Swami Rama of the Himalayas, and the spiritual head of the
Himalayan Institute. As the author of numerous books, including his autobiography Touched by Fire:
The Ongoing Journey of a Spiritual Seeker, Pandit Tigunait offers practical guidance on applying
yogic and tantric wisdom to modern life. For over 40 years he has touched innumerable lives around
the world as a teacher, humanitarian, and visionary spiritual leader. You can view more of his
teachings online at the Himalayan Institute Wisdom Library.

Pandit Tigunait holds two doctorates: one in Sanskrit from the University of Allahabad in India, and
another in Oriental Studies from the University of Pennsylvania. Family tradition gave Pandit
Tigunait access to a vast range of spiritual wisdom preserved in both the written and oral
traditions. Before meeting his master, Pandit Tigunait studied Sanskrit, the language of the ancient
scriptures of India, as well as the languages of the Buddhist, Jaina, and Zorastrian traditions. In
1976, Swami Rama ordained Pandit Tigunait into the 5,000-year-old lineage of the Himalayan Masters.

# THE SIGNAL IN THE NOISE

Water & Music is the go-to research partner for music companies exploring new technologies, business
models, and futures.

We cut through the hype to show you what actually matters in music tech. While others chase
headlines, we dig deeper — mapping real opportunities, spotting patterns across the industry, and
helping you make smarter decisions about partnerships, products, and positioning.

# Built on a foundation of trust

From 2019–2025, our paid membership welcomed 5,000 music industry leaders through our doors.
Together, we:
* Put music tech on the map as a serious $15B+ industry
* Spotted AI, Web3, and gaming trends months before they went mainstream
* Connected co-founders who went on to raise millions in capital
* Built the most trusted network of music tech innovators globally

Today, we're making our past six years of knowledge free, while focusing on cultivating deeper
partnerships with companies ready to lead — not follow — in the next wave of technological change.

# THE SIGNAL IN THE NOISE

Water & Music is the go-to research partner for music companies exploring new technologies, business
models, and futures.

We cut through the hype to show you what actually matters in music tech. While others chase
headlines, we dig deeper — mapping real opportunities, spotting patterns across the industry, and
helping you make smarter decisions about partnerships, products, and positioning.

# Built on a foundation of trust

From 2019–2025, our paid membership welcomed 5,000 music industry leaders through our doors.
Together, we:
* Put music tech on the map as a serious $15B+ industry
* Spotted AI, Web3, and gaming trends months before they went mainstream
* Connected co-founders who went on to raise millions in capital
* Built the most trusted network of music tech innovators globally

Today, we're making our past six years of knowledge free, while focusing on cultivating deeper
partnerships with companies ready to lead — not follow — in the next wave of technological change.

# Wat Pa Tam Wua

A beautiful and peaceful Buddhist Forest Monastery open to everyone.

## Plan a meditation retreat at Wat Pa Tam Wua

Wat Pa Tam Wua is a Theravada Buddhist Forest Monastery in Mae Hong Son, Northern Thailand. People
of every background are welcome to learn Buddhist practice in a peaceful monastic setting. Start
with our [**complete meditation retreat in Thailand guide**][24] for an honest overview of the stay.

### No booking

Walk in any day of the year and check in between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM.

### Stay 3–10 days

Three days is the recommended minimum; ten days is the usual maximum.

### Offered freely

Accommodation, bedding, white clothes and vegetarian meals are provided without charge. Donations
are welcome.

### Monastic practice

Guests follow the daily timetable, attend required sessions and observe the monastery rules.

This is a working Buddhist monastery, not a hotel or wellness resort. Please read the practical
information before travelling and arrive prepared to participate fully.

[Read the retreat guide][25][Plan your journey][26][View the timetable][27]

## Wat Pa Tam Wua Books

### "Walk to be the Knower"

Want to learn more about Buddha, Dharma, Vipassana meditation and our monastery?

Welcome to download the online book written by Phra Anek Thanissarapoti, one of the monks of Wat Pa
Tam Wua! This book is a great source of knowledge, it includes:
* Life of the Buddha
* What did the Buddha teach
* Handbook of Vipassana
* About Wat Tam Wua Forest Monastery

[Download Book][29]
[Walk to be the Knower — book by Phra Anek Thanissarapoti]
[Mantras Chanting Book — Wat Pa Tam Wua]

### Mantras Chanting Book

In this Chanting Book, first we talk about some of the essentials: Buddha, Dhamma and Sangha.

Then we explain one of the Mindfulness techniques we actively using in our monastery: "Practice
Mindfulness in bow down three times".

You will also find all the chantings that we practice at Wat Pa Tam Wua every evening. We always
chant in three languages: Pali, Thai and English.

[Download Chanting Book][30]
